{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Cross-tabulate arm with key covariates to check balance

# Site
site_balance = pd.crosstab(data['arm'], data['site'])
print('Site balance:')
print(site_balance)

# Severity
severity_balance = pd.crosstab(data['arm'], data['severity'])
print('\nSeverity balance:')
print(severity_balance)

# Sex
sex_balance = pd.crosstab(data['arm'], data['sex'])
print('\nSex balance:')
print(sex_balance)

# Age (check mean)
age_control = data[data['arm'] == 'control']['age'].mean()
age_treatment = data[data['arm'] == 'treatment']['age'].mean()
print(f'\nMean age - control: {age_control:.2f}, treatment: {age_treatment:.2f}')"}
